race.comment: TERRACOTTA ROSE (2) is in top form after winning at Gatton and placing in CL2 at Ipswich on her return. Third-up with two wins from five starts at 1000m, the 3kg claim enhances her chances. WORTHY (1) poses a fresh threat after a CL 1 win at Ipswich, where she led to win by just under two lengths on heavy ground. Returns from an eight-month spell, but a solid Toowoomba trial sets her up well. OCEAN JOY (5) brings winning form from Dalby, coming from the back to win by a head in BM55 company. With a solid 1000m starts, she's competitive. VESPER LYND (7) returns from five weeks off after a third in CL4 at this track, finishing just over 2L back. Draws well and keeps a 2kg claim. In the mix.
